items.title: APIRuntime does not start with storage.backend: postgres (api/core/bootstrap.py:126)
items.reason: Blocks all PostgreSQL users from starting the API runtime/CLI. Fix is merged but unreleased, so status label is correct.

items.title: Backend without atomic capture: each consolidation run re-extracts up to batch_limit intents and adds one more pending intent
items.reason: Unbounded data growth (pending 1→15 over 14 runs) and wasted model spend; highest concrete-impact issue still marked in progress.

items.title: Identity hard constraint `NEVER write memory records` denies cron capture recovery, but a turn's own terminal capture writes with no policy check
items.reason: Security-policy bypass: two gates deny the same write while the terminal path performs it unchecked. Highest trust impact in the set.

items.title: PostgreSQL: storage migrate modules share one alembic_version, runtime storage then fails on sessions
items.reason: Schemas diverge from the declared migration state on Postgres; error-reporting PR improves diagnosis but does not resolve the collision.

items.title: APIRuntime start that fails after storage is built closes nothing: SQLite files and PostgreSQL connections stay open
items.reason: Resource leak on startup failure; masked by #437 since that failure is now the common trigger.

items.title: Scheduled memory consolidation turn captures itself: gateway drops the memory_consolidation_job marker
items.reason: Root cause of the self-capture and pending-intent growth in #449; fix merged, so awaiting-release is accurate.

items.title: [0.1.12] @tool arguments typed as a Pydantic model or dataclass reach the function as a plain dict
items.reason: Public SDK contract break that silently degrades agents; fix shipped in the 0.1.14 package line.

items.title: `python -m openminion.modules.storage` exits 0 when storagectl main() returns 2
items.reason: Exit-code lie breaks CI/scripting detection of storage failures; narrow one-line fix already merged.

items.title: Upgrade guide: storage backup refuses 10 of a runtime home's 17 SQLite files; turn-start reset writes pre-#419 working-state shape
items.reason: Documentation-only gap with merged guidance; no code change required.

items.title: Report the migration error in `storage migrate` entries
items.reason: Only open PR in the window and it is unlabeled, so it will not surface in triage views. Directly aids #446 diagnosis.

items.title: Preserve trusted consolidation context
items.reason: Largest behavioral change: bound trusted projection to task provenance and pauses unverifiable legacy jobs. Addresses #456/#449 and touches #448.
